purpose: Witness the candidate invariant layer for EMS_Δ without collapsing it into equality, a scalar metric, topology, or physical conservation.

non_claims: Does not assert scalar metric structure.
Does not assert topology or differentiability.
Does not promote Inv_M to theorem status.

witnesses.name: Order witness
witnesses.statement: Admissible re-expression of the same governed trace preserves ordinal ordering.

witnesses.name: Trace witness
witnesses.statement: The history of lawful transitions can be reconstructed from the transformed record.

witnesses.name: Boundary witness
witnesses.statement: Boundary identity remains legible under admissible rebinding.

forbidden_inferences: Inv_M does not imply a metric space.
Inv_M does not imply coordinate geometry.
Inv_M does not imply physical conservation law.
non_claims: Does not define a completed metric.
Does not define a physical field.
Does not define a conservation law.
Does not update the textbook by itself.
